name: aaronyang-agent-plugins
description: Aaron Yang's agent plugins for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot

plugins.name: knowledge-work
plugins.description: A working method for knowledge work with agents: lean agent rules verified with evals, plain explanations, notes that follow your knowledge base, a reflection queue, and orchestrating long sessions

plugins.name: software-design
plugins.description: Design and review systems with explicit trade-offs: boundaries and dependency direction, single source of truth, functional core, domain interfaces and contracts, restraint (KISS, YAGNI, DRY), patterns only when they fit, supply-chain-aware dependencies, and incremental migration

plugins.name: gmail-tools
plugins.description: Gmail as code: archive statement and receipt PDFs by month, manage filters from a TOML file with lint and backfill, and triage the inbox

plugins.name: file-archiving
plugins.description: File personal documents safely: PARA structure, hash-verified moves, append-only evidence, yearly folders, manifests as the source of truth

plugins.name: ms-atwork
plugins.description: Download every document and report from Morgan Stanley at Work into a local folder with a manifest; you sign in yourself
